hooks.command: node -e "process.env.ENGRAM_HOOK_EVENT='SessionStart';const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),os=require('node:os'),d='dispatcher.cjs';function parts(v){return String(v).split(/[^0-9]+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number)}function cmp(a,b){const aa=parts(a),bb=parts(b),m=Math.max(aa.length,bb.length);for(let i=0;i<m;i++){const n=(aa[i]||0)-(bb[i]||0);if(n)return n}return String(a).localeCompare(String(b))}function fromRoot(r){if(!r)return null;return [path.join(r,'hooks',d),path.join(r,d)].find(f=>fs.existsSync(f))||null}function cacheRoots(){const h=process.env.CODEX_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.codex');const bases=[path.join(h,'plugins','cache','engram-marketplace','engram'),path.join(h,'plugins','cache','engram','engram')];return bases.flatMap(b=>{let e=[];try{e=fs.readdirSync(b,{withFileTypes:true})}catch(_){return []}return e.filter(x=>x.isDirectory()).map(x=>x.name).sort((a,b)=>cmp(b,a)).map(n=>path.join(b,n))})}const roots=[process.env.CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.CODEX_PLUGIN_DIR,process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT,...cacheRoots(),process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DIR];const f=roots.map(fromRoot).find(Boolean);if(f){const m=require(f);if(m&&typeof m.main==='function')m.main()}else{process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({continue:true})+'\n')}"
